profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Accesso
profile.summary:
I am an experienced and highly skilled Java/J2EE - LAMP software engineer with more than 10 years experience in the IT sector.

I have been working in leading research and development companies in Spain and I also have experience overseas working in the UK. 
During this time I have been progressing constantly, learning new technologies and gaining more responsibilities from starting my trainee in Telefonica to the role of CTO at the startup fidiliti.

I’m self-motivated, ambitious, friendly and quick learner; I also set myself goals frequently and thanks to that I make the most of my time like, for instance, developing varied projects by my own. I seek to further develop my skills in a challenging position.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the server team of Toggle, a Mobile Device Management application for enterprises that separates work and personal data on the device. Architecture based on RabbitMQ and CakePHP, Java, Spring, using multiple queues, a set of well defined state machines and a collection of Shells controlled by a supervisor.

▫ Duties:
· Analysis and development of new functionalities as well as bugs resolution.
· Refactoring existing code to: reduce response time, make unit testable code, apply design patterns, remove duplicated functionality.  
· Reducing bugs handed to QA based on previous taken records.
· Actively participating on production releases.

▫ Skills:
LAMP, RabbitMQ, CakePHP, TDD, Scrum, Backbone.js, Jenkins, SVN, Spring Boot, Java, Hibernate, Maven, web services, nginx.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
▫ Positions held:
CTO

▫ Duties:
• Managing technology team.
• Applying Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
• Improving server and sites response time.

▫ Skills:
Linux, MySQL, Tomcat, J2EE, Spring, Hibernate, Axis2

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Working as LAMP analyst/developer in the startup We2, a social WiFi android/iOS/web app, following a scrum methodology.

▫ Positions held:
	IT Consultat / Backend developer

▫ Duties:
• Designing database architecture.
• Designing and developing backend services using PHP/MySQL/Propel.
• Managing users’ sessions to more than 500 hotspots.
• Improvement of service responses using caching methods.
• Development of captive portal as landing sites for users in hotspots.

▫ Skills:
Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP, Propel ORM, Backend, web services, JSON, Amazon S3, AWS, Memcache, Log4php, PHPUnit, Jira, Scrum, GIT, JSON, HTML, CSS, jQuery, TDD, Jmeter, Graphite

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Chief Technology officer at the startup Fidiliti, loyalty cards application for web, Android and iPhone devices.

▫ Positions held:
	CTO / Entrepreneur

▫ Duties:
• Re-designing database architecture.
• Managing development team, planing tasks.
• Improvement of existing web services, getting best performance.
• Reducing response time for current processes.
• Setting up the site, webservices, Android and iPhone apps to be fully working.
• Development of the CodeIgniter web site and Android app.

▫ Skills:
Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP, CodeIgniter, jQuery, CSS, JavaScript, web services, XML, Android, REST, JSON, jQuery Mobile, PhoneGap.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.locationName: Las Rozas De Madrid Area, Spain
positions.description:
Manager of the e-commerce Club Outlet (apparels outlet), controlling several divisions: Marketing, Technology, Design and Customer Service. I was mainly developing front and backend for the website along with a programmer.


Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP, (LAMP), jQuery, Joomla, CSS, JavaScript, web services, REST, mailing marketing, SEO, social media.

• Management of a 5 people team.
• Newsletters statistics (opens, clicks, bounces...).
• SEO On-page and Off-page optimization.
• Development Joomla and Virtuemart modules and plugins (PHP).
• Improvement of the backend and fronted of the website (jQuery, CSS, JavaScript).

positions.title: Java Analyst
positions.description: Working as a Java Analyst and programmer on two projects to work out optimal seat fares for different flights; using dynamic pogramming, multi-threading process and statistical functions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
· Analysing best solutions for new back-end developments (LAMP) and designing data base structures.
· Development: back-end and front-end of new and existing sites (different multidisciplinary
projects).
· Setting up cron jobs and creating shell scripts.
· Use of SEO techniques for different sites.
· Analysis: the structure of websites and returning data on their structure and the information they contain, in the form of a data extraction 'template' for each site using regular expressions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java, J2EE, Oracle 9i, MySQL, JavaScript, PHP, Java Server Pages, XHMTL, framework TidForms (Ajax architecture), WebServices (toolkit Axis 1.2 and 2.0), IBM MQSeries, Shell scripting, Java Message Service, Servlets, multi-threading, Apache, Tomcat, Ant, design patterns, JDBC.

• Developed software using MVC - 4 layers architecture with tidforms framework, including multi-threading techniques.
• Develop and implement software for Telefonica R+D, at the first stages I developed using: PHP, JSP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and XML.
• Different multi-disciplinary projects.
• Worked with HP-UX and Windows XP operating systems.

Development: Programming, debugging, testing and documentation.
Deployment: Distribution, installation and support of 24 hours services to customers with immediate response and problem-solving (under 1 hour service).

positions.title: Trainee Software Developer
positions.description:
Java, data base access (Java – Oracle), Java Script, Java Server Pages, Applets, XML, JSP.

• Developed software for Telefonica.
• Several projects dedication.
• Worked with Windows NT/2000 operating systems.

Development: Programming, debugging, testing and documentation.
